players.product: Turnkey custom-chip (ASIC) design and mass-production services for AI/data-processing chips, plus licensed GPU, GPGPU, NPU and VPU processor IP

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman, CEO and president Dai Weimin (2025 annual results briefing): building on their earlier Open Se Cura open-source project, VeriSilicon and Google jointly built the Coral NPU IP, an ultra-low-power NPU IP based on the RISC-V instruction set for on-device large-language-model applications; Google provides the open-source technology and VeriSilicon provides enterprise-grade IP, chip design and mass-production services, offering 'lightweight, always-on, ultra-low-power' edge AI solutions for smart glasses, wearables and AI toys. He said the inflection point for edge AI is the move from 'technically feasible' to 'commercial scale', marked by mature lightweight models and dedicated low-power AI ASICs, breakout products such as AI phones and smart glasses, and a surge in upstream chip-design orders; while keeping its cloud AI ASIC base, the company is expanding its edge AI ASIC solution platforms for AI phones, AI PCs and AI pads and for AI glasses, AI toys, AI rings and smart mobility. He also said the rising revenue share of customer projects where VeriSilicon's participation and added value are higher is lifting its bargaining power, which should help profitability.
